goal: Rebuild MNP reservation-number / One-Stop guidance as a unified procedure master with current exact evidence for high-priority carriers and preserved legacy evidence dates for long-tail services.
outputs: 9 existing Japanese MNP pages wired to the unified panel
key_results: MNP One-Stop and reservation-number issuance are modeled as separate flows.
Web/app/phone/store route, hours, step sequence, delivery method, validity, reissue/cancellation, authentication, blockers, special contracts and known error states are structured fields.
Data-only/SMS-only contracts are not assumed MNP-eligible.
docomo/ahamo representative-line, billing, Hikari pair and Data Plus prerequisite states are retained.
SoftBank/Y!mobile after-20:00 notification behavior is currentized.
Rakuten Mobile same-day issue and OTP flow are currentized.
povo2.0 data-only exclusion and same-day/account-state blockers are currentized.
63 long-tail services retain their original 2026-08-08 official evidence date instead of being silently promoted.
SoftBank repair and Y!mobile repair/loaner restrictions remain explicitly marked as 2026-08-08 legacy evidence because Phase171 did not reconfirm those conditions.

evidence_model.reason: MNP reservation issuance is primarily an account/procedure domain; current carrier primary-source evidence is the authoritative layer. Real account-flow captures can later add UI evidence without replacing official rules.

next_step: Phase172: reverify high-value MVNOs (IIJmio, mineo, BIGLOBE, Nihon Tsushin SIM, HIS Mobile, NURO Mobile, AEON Mobile) into current_exact records and extend error-state diagnostics without increasing URL count.
